request.body: `schedule_wake` accepts timestamps in the past (e.g. `2025-01-01T00:00:00Z`), and successfully returns `next wake scheduled: 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z`. This is a harness bug that could cause immediate re-wakes or lock the scheduler in an infinite loop since the time has already passed.
request.resolution: Confirmed and fixed: wakes must now be at least a minute in the future. $5 bounty paid. Good catch.
